description: Maantieteellisten nimien NLS-FI INSPIRE -latauspalvelu (WFS) is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire-wfs.maanmittauslaitos.fi. NLS-FI INSPIRE Download Service (WFS) for Geographical Names Theme is an INSPIRE compliant direct access Web Feature Service. It contains the following INSPIRE feature types: NamedPlace. The service is based on the Geographic Names Register of the National Land Survey of Finland. The dataset is administrated by the National Land Survey of Finland. Coverage: FI. The portal shows the English title as "NLS-FI INSPIRE Download Service (WFS) for Geographical Names" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
